hook: SHE HAS NOT HAD *HOT TEA IN TWENTY *YEARS
title: F30 · cold_tea · Her Tea Is Always Cold
lines: n
She made that cup forty minutes ago.
n
Tiffin. Uniform. Keys. Mummy, where is my...
Tiffin. Uniform. Keys. "Mummy, where is my..."
n
She feeds five people before eight.
She eats standing, after everyone has left.
n
She picked up the cup. Cold. As always.
n
In the tea, a kitchen door. A woman with a ladle. And the lord of the universe, waiting in line.
n
Even he had to stand at her door.
n
She poured the cold tea away.
Made a new one. And sat down. On a chair. For eleven minutes.
n
The one who feeds everyone must be fed. That is sadhana.
n
